description: Read a whole conversation with message bodies: the tool for finding out what was said. Pass the id of any inbound email in the thread. Each message has a direction and a role (inbound→user, outbound→assistant). Texts have links as [link] and quoted history removed; full: true returns them as stored, with message ids. A brand-new message has thread_id null and one message. For link targets, use getEmail (links: "all") or getSentEmail (full: true). For a thread of only messages you sent, use listSentEmails and getSentEmail. Result: thread_id, subject, messages, quoted_chars_removed (0 with full), and when given, message_count and truncated (message cap reached).

full.description: Return the stored record, with links, quoted history and message ids, instead of the compact view for reading.

id.description: Any inbound email in the thread, by its id from listEmails or searchEmails.

name: getConversation

outputSchema.description: The whole thread, oldest message first.

message_count.description: Messages in the thread; more than returned when truncated.

attachments.description: Files on it; absent when none.

filename.description: File name; null when the email gave none.

part_index.description: Pass to getEmailAttachment to read it.

id.description: Email id: getEmail for inbound, getSentEmail for outbound.

role.description: user for inbound, assistant for outbound.

text.description: Readable text, with links as [link]; as stored with full.

timestamp.description: When it was sent or received.

quoted_chars_removed.description: Characters of quoted history left out of the texts; 0 with full.

thread_id.description: Conversation id; null for a brand-new message.

truncated.description: True when the message cap was reached.

title: Get conversation
